text:
Priya Patel: Quick heads-up — opened PR #482 to migrate Console metrics docs to the new metrics-v2 schema. Need: SDK snippet for cost breakdown (Node + Python), a linkcheck, and an updated screenshot. Assigning reviewers: @Alex Kim and @Sam Liu.
Alex Kim: Skimmed the PR, overall structure looks good. Can you add a small Node example calling the SDK (not the internal HTTP path)? Keep it <=6 lines. Also add a note about the query window. :eyes: 
Priya Patel: Posted a draft Node line in the PR comment: `const res = await client.console.getMetrics({ range: '1h', groupBy: 'route', metric: 'cost' });` — is that the canonical call?
Jonah Reyes: Minor correction — SDK surface is `client.console.metrics.query(...)`. Example I usually use: ```js
// Node
const res = await client.console.metrics.query({
  window: '1h',
  group_by: 'route',
  metrics: ['cost']
});
```
Priya Patel: Perfect, thanks Jonah. I'll paste that. Can you add the Python equivalent?
Jonah Reyes: Sure — ```py
# Python
res = client.console.metrics.query({
  "window": "1h",
  "group_by": "route",
  "metrics": ["cost"],
})
```
Sam Liu: Quick linkcheck on my laptop found one broken link in the draft: `/docs/console/old-metrics` -> 404. docs-bot reported it in CI too. We should add a redirect or update the link.
docs-bot: link-checker: found 1 broken link in /docs/console/metrics-v2/quickstart -> `/docs/console/old-metrics` (HTTP 404). Preview: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.com/metrics-v2/quickstart
Sam Liu: I'll open a tiny PR to add the redirect rule in netlify/_redirects and update the internal link to the canonical metrics-v2 page. Assigning to eng-platform for telemetry rename question. @eng-platform-bot any objections to renaming label `route` -> `route_name` in metrics-v2?
eng-platform-bot: Telemetry update request received. No blocking objections; note that changing label names requires a migration in the ingestion pipeline. ETA for review: 2 business days. Recommend adding a compatibility note in docs for both labels.
Priya Patel: Good call — we'll add a short compatibility note describing both `route` and `route_name` and when each shows up.
Eva Fernández: I can export the updated cost dashboard screenshot from Prod Console. Will upload to `assets/screenshots/metrics_v2_cost.png`. ETA ~2h.
Alex Kim: For the quickstart page, can we also include a tiny tracing hook snippet showing how to attach `redwood.route` and `redwood.model` to spans? One-liner is fine.
Jonah Reyes: Suggested tracing snippet: ```js
span.setAttribute('redwood.route', routeName);
span.setAttribute('redwood.model', modelName);
``` — add below SDK examples with a short caption: "Attach these attributes to your tracing spans to correlate traces with console metrics."
Sam Liu: I'll add Node + Python snippets, the compatibility note, and run the linkcheck locally before pushing. Will also add a tiny callout about cost units (USD per 1k tokens) to avoid confusion.
Priya Patel: Awesome. Once Sam pushes and Eva uploads the screenshot, I'll merge PR #482. Leaving the PR open for now — tagging reviewers: @Alex Kim, @Jonah Reyes. Thanks team! :party_parrot: 
Alex Kim: Thanks — will review once the screenshot lands. :+1:
docs-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.com/metrics-v2/quickstart — includes current snippets and draft notes.
Priya Patel: Merge blocked until screenshot + redirect. Marking this thread with label: docs/needs-asset.
Eva Fernández: Uploaded screenshot and left it in the PR files. Link: https://assets.redwood.com/screenshots/metrics_v2_cost.png
Sam Liu: Redirect PR opened: #483. Ran linkcheck locally, no more 404s. Pushing final commit to #482 with the snippets and compatibility note.
Priya Patel: Merged PR #482 (after final review). Thanks everyone — followups: watch the telemetry migration announcement from eng-platform and update the changelog if label names change.
Alex Kim: Nice work!
_notes: This thread is a docs coordination conversation for Console/observability docs migration, snippets, link fixes, tracing hook example, screenshot and telemetry label compatibility.
